eekes_form_builder.spam_protection_info: What a check catches is answered like a real submission, so a bot never learns it was caught. It is not sent or passed to integrations, but kept in the Spam tab, where a person caught by mistake can be released.
eekes_form_builder.spam_check.honeypot_i: A hidden field that people never see and bots fill in. Needs no service, cookie or JavaScript.
eekes_form_builder.spam_without_answers: The answers of blocked submissions are not stored on this website, so this one cannot be released.
eekes_form_builder.form_key_info: Renders the form in a template with %placeholder:eekes_form('key')%. Leave empty to derive it from the title.
eekes_form_builder.after_submit_message: A message in place of the form
eekes_form_builder.success_message_info: Leave empty for a standard thank-you message.
eekes_form_builder.buttons_info: Leave empty for the standard labels.
eekes_form_builder.store_submissions_inf: Switch off when the e-mails are enough, so personal data is not kept longer than needed.
eekes_form_builder.notification_name_inf: Only shown in the admin, e.g. "Confirmation to visitor".
eekes_form_builder.recipients_info: Separate addresses with a comma. %placeholder:email% sends to what the visitor filled in in the field with the key "email".
eekes_form_builder.from_email_info: Leave empty for the sender of the website.
eekes_form_builder.message_info: Use %placeholder:field_key% for an answer, and %placeholder:form_title%, %placeholder:url% or %placeholder:date%.
eekes_form_builder.subject: Subject
eekes_form_builder.include_values_label: Add all answers below the text
eekes_form_builder.conditions_info: Only send this e-mail when all conditions are met, e.g. to send questions about sales to the sales team.
eekes_form_builder.field_type.heading: Heading
eekes_form_builder.field.label: Label
eekes_form_builder.field.required_label: The visitor has to fill this in
eekes_form_builder.field.show_in_list_la: Show in the list of submissions
eekes_form_builder.field.show_in_list_in: The other answers are one click away in the column settings.
eekes_form_builder.field.key_info: Used in e-mails as %placeholder:key% and by developers. Leave empty to derive it from the label.
eekes_form_builder.field.extensions_info: Comma separated, e.g. pdf, docx. Empty allows everything.
eekes_form_builder.field.default_value_i: Sent along with every submission. A developer can also fill it from code.
eekes_form_builder.field.preferred_count: Country codes, comma separated, e.g. BE, NL.
eekes_form_builder.field.choices_info: Only translate the labels in other languages; conditions and e-mails rely on the values.
eekes_form_builder.field.choice_value_in: Optional; the label is used when empty.
eekes_form_builder.field.rating_to_info: The highest score, from 2 to 10. Empty means 5.
eekes_form_builder.field.sub_fields_info: The visitor fills in these fields once per entry, and adds as many entries as needed, e.g. a first name, last name and e-mail address per participant.
eekes_form_builder.field.sub_field_key_i: Letters, digits and underscores, starting with a letter, e.g. first_name. Integrations and webhooks receive the answer under this key.
eekes_form_builder.field.repeater_row_la: Shown above every entry with its number, e.g. "Participant" becomes "Participant 2".
eekes_form_builder.field.repeater_add_la: E.g. "Add a participant". Empty shows "Add another".
eekes_form_builder.field.repeater_min_in: A required repeater needs at least one entry.
eekes_form_builder.field.checkbox_label_: May contain a link, e.g. to your privacy policy.
eekes_form_builder.remove_step_confirm: Remove this step and all its fields?
eekes_form_builder.empty_step: Add a field from the list on the right.
eekes_form_builder.layout_info: Out of 12 columns. Fields placed side by side share a row as long as they fit.
eekes_form_builder.step_visible_info: A step whose condition is not met is skipped.
eekes_form_builder.duplicate_failed: The form could not be duplicated.
eekes_form_builder.missing_type: This field type no longer exists; the field is not shown on the website.
sulu_activity.description.eekes_forms.co: Form "{resourceTitle}" was created as a copy by {userFullName}
eekes_form_builder.flow_name_info: Only shown in the admin, e.g. "Newsletter subscribers to Mailchimp".
eekes_form_builder.flow_conditions_info: Only run this flow when the conditions are met, e.g. only when the newsletter box is ticked.
eekes_form_builder.integration.webhook_d: Posts the submission as JSON to an endpoint your developer configured, e.g. for Zapier, Make or n8n.
eekes_form_builder.mapping_info: Fill every field the integration needs with an answer or a fixed value. Fields marked * are required.
eekes_form_builder.add_custom_field: Add a field of your own
eekes_form_builder.load_options_failed: The choices could not be loaded
eekes_form_builder.load_fields_failed: The fields of the account could not be loaded, add them by their key instead
eekes_form_builder.remove_used_field: Remove a field an integration uses?
eekes_form_builder.remove_used_field_inf: These flows use this field and will no longer get its answer:
eekes_form_builder.make_optional_title: Make a field optional that a flow needs?
eekes_form_builder.make_optional_info: These flows need an answer to this field. A submission that leaves it empty will fail in them:
eekes_form_builder.no_runs: No integration ran for this submission.
eekes_form_builder.required_when_empty: Only required when "Required" is switched on.
eekes_form_builder.required_when_info: Make the field required depending on other answers, e.g. a phone number once a call back is asked for.
eekes_form_builder.integration_disconnec: Flows of this integration fail until it is connected again.
eekes_form_builder.integration_redirect_: Redirect URI to register with the service
eekes_form_builder.integration_no_permis: Ask someone with access to Settings → Form builder integrations to fix this.
eekes_form_builder.webhook.test_failed: Not every endpoint accepted the test; the status of each is below.
eekes_form_builder.integration_send_test: This sends a test message to every endpoint, marked with "test": true. Whatever is connected there will receive it.
eekes_form_builder.integration_test_afte: You can test the connection once the steps above are done.
eekes_form_builder.requirement.set_env: Set the environment variable %env% (it is empty now).
eekes_form_builder.requirement.env_missi: The environment variable %env% is not defined at all. Add it to .env (it may be empty) or to the environment of the server.
eekes_form_builder.integration_not_build: The integration cannot be loaded: its configuration needs an environment variable that does not exist.
eekes_form_builder.email_template_info: How the e-mail looks. The preview below shows it with sample answers.
eekes_form_builder.email_template.card: Card – the text on a card, answers below (default)
eekes_form_builder.email_template.plain: Plain – reads like a personal e-mail, for confirmations
eekes_form_builder.email_template.summar: Summary – answers first, with a button to the admin, for the team
eekes_form_builder.email_preview_info: The e-mail as it is being edited, with sample answers for the fields of the form.
eekes_form_builder.email_test_failed: The test could not be sent
eekes_form_builder.email_preview_failed: The preview could not be made.
